pricing.notes: Matomo Cloud EUR prices from matomo.org/pricing/ JSON-LD UnitPriceSpecification, checked 24 Nov 2026 (excl. tax): €22 at 50K hits (USD $26), then €38 / €75 / €118 / €172 / €334 / €822 / €1,600 through 10M hits. On-Premise Community is €0; paid bundles start at Team €230/month.

projectLimits.notes: A Matomo Cloud Business plan includes up to 30 websites. Enterprise allowances are custom. Self-hosted has no site cap. Cloud data is stored in Frankfurt, Germany per Matomo pricing FAQ.
